title: Tokyo markets closed — Autumnal Equinox Day; the second Tokyo holiday inside one four-session week
source: NEWS: jpx.co.jp/english/corporate/about-jpx/calendar/ ('Market Holidays'), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 33,103 bytes — the same byte count the jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 entry recorded on 2026-09-05) and parsed row-by-row out of its 2027 panel by this session. The 2027 panel reads, in order: 'Aug. 11 (Wed.) Mountain Day | Sep. 20 (Mon.) Respect for the Aged Day | **Sep. 23 (Thu.) Autumnal Equinox** | Oct. 11 (Mon.) Sports Day'. The weekday label (Thu.) is the disambiguation that this is the 2027 panel: the adjacent 2026 panel reads 'Sep. 23 (Wed.) Autumnal Equinox'. CORROBORATED BY AN INDEPENDENT STATUTORY PRIMARY SOURCE, fetched direct 2026-09-09: the Japanese Cabinet Office's own national-holiday register (www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/syukujitsu.csv, HTTP 200, 21,538 bytes, Shift-JIS), the publisher of record under the Act on National Holidays, lists '2027/9/23,秋分の日' (Autumnal Equinox Day). NOTE ON WHY THIS DATE CANNOT BE DERIVED THE WAY THE OTHERS CAN: Autumnal Equinox Day is the one Japanese national holiday with no fixed calendar rule — it is set each year from the astronomical instant of the equinox and formally proclaimed by the Cabinet in the February of the preceding year, so for 2027 it rests on the two fetched sources above and on nothing derivable. Filed estimate on the same counts as its 2027-09-20 sibling: no confirmed-tier prefix in market-events-data.ts covers an exchange's or a foreign cabinet office's holiday calendar, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and JPX's own note warns that exchange holidays are subject to change under Japan's Act on National Holidays. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-09-20, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-09-20 initial research (2026-09-09), filed alongside jpx-market-closure-2027-09-20 because both are dated adjacencies inside the proposer's five-day corridor and both rest on the same two primary fetches. WHY BOTH RATHER THAN JUST THE ONE ON THE PROPOSER'S OWN SESSION: the pair is the fact, not either date alone. Tokyo trades only THREE cash sessions in the week of 2027-09-20 — Tuesday 09-21, Wednesday 09-22 and Friday 09-24 — because Monday and Thursday are both shut. That is a materially compressed week for anyone attributing a Nikkei move to a US catalyst, and it brackets the proposer's effective open on both sides: the 09-21 bar carries a three-day gap of US news (the 2027-09-15 FOMC aftermath, the 2027-09-17 quarterly triple witching, and the 09-20 Russell effective open), and the 09-24 bar carries a two-day gap again. A lane reading either bar as a clean reaction to any single US event will be wrong twice in one week unless it knows this. IMPACT IS LOW and structural only: no house playbook is calendar-keyed and symbols is empty. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no slot for an exchange-schedule event, so this is filed 'sector' — the same least-wrong choice its 2027-09-20 sibling, jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 and good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 all documented, and a further data point for the standing open question of whether the union needs a 'market-structure' member.
